items.text: Welcome back, Ghost Hunters.
[p align="start"]

[p align="start"]Today, we have released the Resonance update for Phasmophobia. The update is now available across all platforms where Phasmophobia is available. If you encounter any issues in downloading the update, or following, please do contact us via our Help Centre.
[p align="start"]
[p align="start"]Below, you’ll find details on what is included in the Resonance update, or you can head to our recent Development Preview for more information.
[p align="start"]
[p align="start"]
[p align="start"]
[p align="start"]

Unity 6: The move to Unity 6 brings with it improvements across the board for Phasmophobia including performance, stability, lighting and more. Phasmophobia also now supports various different quality presets for in-game systems and different platforms such as Steam Deck. Importantly, this update brings with it a host of bug fixes, all of which can be found below.

Performance Improvements & New Options: Unity 6 and its accompanying features has improved Phasmophobia’s performance and stability through notable changes. Resonance addresses commonly encountered crashes, improves CPU, GPU, VRAM and RAM usage as well as allowing for new overall quality presets. Elsewhere, a new Extreme shadow setting for compatible hardware has been added and an option to turn off/on the Live Camera Feed (for Photo & Video Cameras) is now available. Note: If Live Camera Feed is turned off, the Media highlight will still appear on the Camera.

Lighting Improvements: As detailed in the recent Development Preview, Resonance brings with it an overhaul to the overall lighting system in Phasmophobia. These changes will be notable during all weather types where darker areas of a location will be lit through windows and doorways, and outside areas will be brighter. Areas of improvement also cover lighting on dynamic objects such as props and doors; originally, an interactable would be lit in a different way to others whereas now these will blend with the rest of the environment.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37002678/c34e6f2b21b267579476d197ac9df7628fbbaccd.jpg"]
As this lighting change is game-wide, we'll be looking out for any and all feedback via our Help Centre to help us continue to improve and refine it.
[p align="start"]

Voice Recognition Improvements & Changes: In Resonance, we've made additions to Voice Recognition to allow for a more immersive experience with new options allowing players the chance to ask for interactions or proof of presence from the Ghost. An additional page in the Journal has been added too, listing off various line options. These new options replace the ability to say certain words or the Ghost’s name to try and increase Ghost activity.

Sound Sensor Map: Once a Sound Sensor has been placed down inside a location, an icon on the Truck’s map will reflect the type of sound as and when it happens. These will ping differently depending on if the sound is a single sound or a looping sound. A sound can only be picked up if it is happening within the range of the Sensor itself.

Dowsing Rods: The Dowsing Rods are a new piece of Equipment used to locate the Bone during any Contract. Designed mainly for use on larger maps, the Dowsing Rods will point players towards the Bone, with higher tiers providing better accuracy such as which floor the Bone can be found on.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37002678/0be93d4757d6d572c364801482b0f7495b15d73c.jpg"]

Map Voting: The Map Voting system has been reworked to allow for a more customised approach for players. Players are now able to select as many maps as they wish to create their own random map pool. Buttons on the Contract board can be used to select all small, medium and large maps separately as well as a randomiser that works in the same way as the original Random polaroid did.
[p align="start"]

Colour Blind options: Various different Colour Blind options are now available. These can now be found within the Settings > Video menu and support the following types of colour blindness: Protanopia, Protanomaly, Deuteranopia, Deuteranomaly, Tritanopia, Tritanomaly, Achromatopsia, Achromatomaly.

In-Game Warnings: As we continue to improve the overall experience for players in Phasmophobia, a new Warning system has been implemented. Initially, these will provide warnings for violations of our Code of Conduct, but we’ll continue to evolve this system as we go. If action is taken against a report, the player who made the report will now receive a notification informing them that it has been successful.

XBOX Play Anywhere: Phasmophobia is now available as part of the XBOX Play Anywhere program, allowing players to play the game across the devices that support XBOX - PC, laptops, ROG Ally and XBOX Series X/S. Save data will carry across your devices, meaning you can switch between any XBOX system and retain your progress.

Console language support - Additional language support for PlayStation 5 and XBOX Series X/S has been added. The following languages are now supported on all platforms: English, German, French, Italian, Bulgarian, Czech, Danish, Dutch, Finnish, Greek, Hungarian, Japanese, Korean, Norwegian, Polish, Romanian, Russian, Simplified Chinese, Swedish, Traditional Chinese, Turkish, Ukrainian, Catalan, Arabic, Spanish (Latin America), Portuguese (Portugal), Spanish (Spain), Portuguese (Brazil).

Eye Adaptation: A new Eye Adaptation setting, Performance, has been added for all players, including VR. The previous On option is now changed to Quality. Note: VR and low end hardware only support the Performance setting.
[p align="start"]
[p align="start"]
Ghost Changes
A Yurei will now open and close doors during Hunts.
A Yurei’s normal interactions with doors are now slightly faster than other Ghost types.
During a Hunt, a Yurei moves doors faster than other Ghost types.
A Poltergeist now has a chance to either throw or interact with objects, rather than only throwing, while still retaining a higher chance to throw objects than other Ghost types.
A Goryo will no longer change rooms if the ‘’I Wish For Sanity’’ Monkey Paw wish is used.
In Settings, ‘Cursor Color’ has been changed to ‘Reticle Color’.
Players using controllers can now switch CCTV tabs in the Truck with DPAD arrows.
The Contracts board now reads as ‘Vote on Contracts’ due to the addition of improved map voting options.
Players who have received a Ban will now have their Cross-play settings locked to ‘Disabled’.

PC players now have the option to choose between Performance & Quality modes for Eye Adaptation. If the player's hardware is unable to support Quality, this will be automatically set to Performance. Note: Consoles will have this automatically set to Performance.
The Truck map will now display the relevant map if on a Restricted variant.
Players on consoles will now be able to change their Cursor color.
Instead of being presented with a ‘Game Full’ message after being invited, the player will now be informed the current Contract is ongoing and to attempt to join once it is finished.
When calibrating height in PSVR2, ‘Trigger’ has been changed to ‘’L2 and R2’’.

items.text: Welcome back, Ghost Hunters.
[p align="start"]Today, we are excited to announce that Resonance, our next major update for Phasmophobia, releases November 24th, 2026 across all platforms.

[p align="start"]Along with our transition to Unity 6, Resonance brings with it the new Dowsing Rods, new Voice Recognition features, improved lighting across the game as well as a host of bug fixes. For a look at what's instore, read our latest Development Preview.
[p align="start"]Full patch notes for Resonance will be released at launch.

Welcome back, Ghost Hunters. We have an update for you.

Today’s small update is in preparation for Crimson Eye, launching 8th October 2026, with the focus on getting the game ready for the start of the event. Our next major update, our move to Unity 6 is scheduled for November and will feature a host of bug fixes and improvements, all of which we’ll detail in an upcoming Development Preview.
New

Crimson Eye - The Crimson Eye is upon us, Ghost Hunters. Once more, various locations across Phasmophobia will be bathed in the red glow of the Blood Moon, offering any willing Ghost Hunter rewards in return for completing investigations, optional objectives and more. For more information on this year’s iteration of the event, please read our latest blogpost.
Seasonal Event toggle - As a new feature for Crimson Eye and future seasonal events, we have implemented a toggle that allows players to turn on/off the event maps for their session.
Fixes
Fixed an issue that caused the white light upon being revived to flash rather than slowly fade in and out.
Fixed an issue where an Easter Egg reward may not unlock, despite a 0x multiplier being active and the reward pop up being displayed.
Known Issues
The lampposts outside of 6 Tanglewood Drive may glow when viewed by the player.
The Fusebox location will not be hidden on the Truck map when playing on a custom difficulty.

Welcome back, Ghost Hunters. We’ve got an update for you.

Today, we have released an update for Phasmophobia to address several issues that were raised following our latest Quality of Life update. Thank you to everyone who has helped with information and feedback to help us identify and fix these bugs.

Our next update following this will be our transition to Unity 6. This will be releasing in November, which is just a little shift from our original aim of October. We’ll be talking in more detail about this update as well as our cosmetics update in an upcoming Development Preview. Rest assured, our Crimson Eye event is still scheduled for October. items.text: Welcome back, Ghost Hunters.
[p align="start"]
[p align="start"]Today we’re going to give you more detail on the upcoming Quality of Life update launching alongside the 13 Willow Street rework on July 21st, 2026.
[p align="start"]

[p align="start"]As mentioned in our recent blogpost, the Quality of Life update itself has been split into two due to the sheer number of fixes & improvements we’ll be implementing. This first update is the bigger of the two, but you can expect the second part in late August.
[p align="start"]
[p align="start"]The below list focuses on changes and fixes coming with this month’s update while the next update will contain further improvements.
[p align="start"]

[p align="start"]While there’s a lot in the below list, it’s not everything that’ll be launching for Phasmophobia on July 21st, with the update bringing with it new keybinds, including PC players being able to use 1, 2, 3 and 4 for changing inventory slots, a couple of improvements for evidence collection and of course, the reworked 13 Willow Street. We’ll detail all of these in a blog the week before launch.
[p align="start"]
[p align="start"]
[p align="start"]Changes
The character hand animations for grabbing, dropping, moving doors and hovering over interactable or grabbable objects have been removed to speed up gameplay.
The item drop animation will still play for others in the session, but will not be visible by the Player.
Cosmetics that are no longer able to be earned will not be visible.
The camera zoom in the Customisation shop will now focus on the selected part of the character.
On Sunny Meadows, the Ghost will now only lock the doors to a wing if both it and a player are inside that wing.
Eye Adaptation will now adjust the lighting quicker when opening and closing the Journal.
Console players will now have the ability to enable/disable Eye Adaptation.
The Obake’s shapeshift will now count towards the Ghost video objective.
You can now capture any Media for the Apocalypse challenge, instead of only a photo.
Recording the Ghost Orbs in the Tutorial is now required, instead of only getting it inside the video camera’s screen.
Improved the lighting around the player, allowing for better visibility in darker areas.
Added an icon to the Player ID Card to show if that player is speaking.
Adjusted the visuals on the PSVR2 player list popup
Event board map leaflets are now spread over multiple pages
Players can now cancel Use animations by pressing the Use button during the animation, allowing for equipment to be quickly toggled without waiting for the animation to finish
The Journal has now been moved closer for easier readability.
The Journal animation is now significantly faster.
Character legs will now use animations, instead of procedurally generated animations when moving
Improved the detection of photo evidence.
Higher priority unique photos will always take priority.
Unique photos will always take priority over duplicates.

VR - The character will now rotate instantly to match the head rotation when looking straight ahead. When looking down, the character rotation will only turn when an angle threshold has been met to allow easier use of the belt.
VR - The Journal will now be instantly opened upon use.
General Fixes
Fixed an issue where players could be seen through the walls of the Truck when viewing the CCTV.
Fixed an issue that caused Voice Recognition to not work if switching from ‘Voice’ to ‘System’.
Fixed an issue where the cursor would not appear after completing a contract when using a controller.
Improved network stability to reduce disconnects.
Player Character Fixes
Fixed an issue where binding Crouch to X (PlayStation controllers) or A (Xbox controller) prevented players from using the Journal.
Fixed an issue that caused dead player’s eyes to appear incorrect.
Fixed an issue that caused the ID Card to be displayed in front of the character model in the Customisation shop.
Fixed an issue that caused players to become stuck and unable to continue playing after being revived.
Fixed an issue that caused cosmetic settings to be reset if a Player joins or leaves a lobby.
Fixed an issue in Nell’s Diner that caused the player to become stuck in the corner of the Freezer Room.
Fixed an issue that allowed infinite sprinting while closing the Journal.
Fixed an issue that caused issues with the character model’s right arm when holding certain pieces of Equipment.
Fixed an issue that caused the cursor to become invisible in the Customisation shop if the left and right mouse buttons were clicked alternatively.
Fixed various visual inconsistencies and errors with character models, cosmetics, equipment and more.
Fixed an issue that caused the audio from the Customisation shop’s UI to be louder than intended.
Fixed an issue that caused a player’s Journal to visually jitter when they swap Equipment.
Equipment Fixes
Fixed an issue that caused the Flashlight to turn invisible when picking up another item.
Fixed an issue that caused the light from a Flashlight to be visible after death.
Fixed an issue that caused Equipment to become invisible.
Fixed an issue that caused the Tier 1 and 3 Firelights to be placed unlit if placed during the lighting animation.
Fixed an issue that caused Equipment to toggle off if dropped while holding the Use button.
Fixed an issue that caused Equipment sounds to become muffled for player’s picking them up after another player dropped them.
Fixed an issue that caused the Flashlight to be unusable if picked up during a placement animation.
Fixed an issue that prevented players from placing the Flashlight back in the Truck.
Fixed an issue that caused the screen to become blurry after enabling Night Vision when using the CCTV unit in the Truck.
Fixed an issue that caused the Tier 3 Incense to not animate correctly when activated.
Fixed an issue that caused a second Salt to be placed if the Player opened the Journal during the placement animation.
Fixed an issue that caused the Sound Recorder visuals and audio to play when not in the player’s hand.
Fixed an issue that caused the Spirit Box to become unusable if the player switched to text recognition after picking the Spirit Box up.
Fixed an issue that caused the Tier 1 Head Gear to be tilted when in use.
Fixed an issue that caused the Flashlight to appear in-hand when equipping 2 handed Cursed Possessions such as the Haunted Mirror.
Fixed an issue that could lock the player if they dropped the Photo Camera during it’s placement animation.
Fixed an issue that caused certain Equipment to be Used after switching to a different piece of Equipment.
Fixed an issue that caused text prompts for the Ouija Board to not work if the player switched from Voice Recognition while using the board.
Fixed an issue that prevented a moving Ouija Board to not be recordable by Video Cameras.
Fixed an issue that prevented a burning Crucifix to not be recordable by the Sound Recorder.
Fixed an issue that caused a second Salt to be placed if the Player opened the Journal during the placement animation.
Fixed an issue that caused inconsistencies with Incense used/unused visuals.
Fixed an issue that could cause Cursed Possessions to become invisible if dropped during a pick-up animation.
Fixed an issue that caused the Haunted Mirror to be blocked by other objects when in Use.
Fixed an issue that allowed players to light the Summoning Circle when at 0 Sanity.
Fixed an issue that caused the player to be softlocked if using a Crucifix at the start of a Hunt.
Fixed an issue that allowed the player to cancel the Ouija Board answer by either dropping or picking up the board if using text recognition.
Ghost Fixes
Fixed an issue that caused all Ghost types to be able to mimic the Yurei’s door ability.
Fixed an issue that prevented the Ghost from interacting with doors it had already interacted with during a Ghost Event.
Fixed an issue that caused the Kormos to be able to hear players during the grace period after a Hunt.
Fixed an issue that allowed the Kormos to hear players during a Hunt, despite the player having used Incense.
Fixed an issue that caused the Kormos to go to the incorrect floor after detecting a player.
Fixed an issue that allowed the Kormos to kill players through walls or from a greater distance than intended.
Fixed an issue that allowed the Phantom to perform its ability on Dead players or players outside.
Location Fixes
Fixed an issue that caused the setup timer to not count down if playing on Amateur/Intermediate on Brownstone High School.
Fixed an issue on Bleasdale Farmhouse where the door to the hiding spot in the Foyer could be opened even if the hiding spot was blocked.
Fixed an issue on Brownstone High School where the side gate could be opened without the key from the Truck.
Fixed an issue that caused the washing machines in Sunny Meadows to not be able to be turned on.
Fixed an issue that caused the player to be unable to open the gates on Camp Woodwind and Maple Lodge Campsite despite the cursor prompt being visible.
Fixed several issues in the Tutorial that caused the player to be unable to exit the Truck or interact with any items.
VR Fixes

With this first Quality of Life update, we’re addressing some immediate issues that VR players are encountering. In our August update, we’ll be implementing a brand new character rig for VR allowing for improved gameplay and animations. We’ll share more details on this in a future blog.
VR - Fixed an issue that caused visual jitters for the Video Camera when attached to as Tier 2 or 3 Tripod.
VR - Fixed an issue that caused Stamina to not recover while crouched.
VR - Fixed an issue that caused Equipment to disappear if the player walks in to a waist-high object.
VR - Fixed an issue that allowed players to grab Head Gear off of other player’s heads.
VR - Fixed an issue that caused player height inconsistencies in Multiplayer.
VR - Implemented a left hand pose when holding the Ouija Board.
VR - Fixed an issue that prevented the Tier 3 Igniter Use animation from playing correctly.
VR - Fixed an issue that caused the character model’s head to become detached from their body when walking sideways.
VR - Fixed an issue that caused the Head Gear to drop to the floor when placed back on the Truck rack.
VR - Fixed an issue that allowed players to skip parts of the Tutorial by using teleport movement.
VR - Fixed an issue that prevented players from recording evidence whilst holding the Journal.
VR - Fixed an issue that caused the VR UI ray to be affected by the hand animations.
VR - Fixed an issue that caused the interact animation to player when looking at another Player’s items.

Welcome back, Ghost Hunters.
Today we have released our latest update for Phasmophobia, addressing several known issues in the game.

We are aware of the current ongoing issues in-game and are currently implementing fixes and improvements in future updates for Phasmophobia. We’ll be sharing our plans for the rest of 2026 later this month with you all, including a timeline for fixes and updates related to both the Player Character Update and game in general. In the meantime, please continue to provide feedback and bug reports so that our team can investigate as much as possible. You can submit any and all issues via our Support Centre.
New
The VR belt has been reimplemented following player feedback. Players will now also be able to switch between having their Journal and Walkie Talkie on the belt or their shoulder.
The VR belt will only be visible locally, players who are looking at a VR player will see the equipment on their body instead.
Changes
The line of sight ghost speed accelerations implemented in the Player Character Update have been reverted to their original state.
Fixes
Fixed an issue that caused players to become softlocked when using the Spirit Box before interacting with the Truck’s CCTV.
Fixed an issue that allowed the Kormos to kill players through floors.
Fixed an issue that allowed the Kormos to kill players outside.
Fixed an issue that caused the Tier 3 Firelight to not work correctly if placed while lit.
Fixed an issue where player jackets would appear incorrectly when loading into a Multiplayer lobby.
Fixed an issue where pressing ‘Join’ in Multiplayer without having a code entered would cause issues creating lobbies, and remove audio from the game.
Fixed an issue where VR players were unable to use Text Input for the Spirit Box, Monkey Paw and Ouija Board.
Known Issues
Players across all platforms are experiencing issues with voice recognition/voice chat. A fix is being investigated.

Please note: Following this update, players on Windows 7/8 or other out-of-date Windows installs may need to run Windows Update (and restart) for voice chat to connect. This is due to a recent security certificate update on our voice servers. More info can be found here.
As you continue your investigations in Phasmophobia, if you encounter bugs, issues or simply have feedback for our team, please use our Support Centre to submit your reports.

Welcome back, Ghost Hunters.

We want to start today by apologising for our Player Character Update that launched last week. It’s clear we missed the mark on this, and didn’t deliver on our promises to you. Your feedback and your reviews were justified. Our team has grown significantly over the last year, and with that comes a higher standard that, in this case, we failed to meet.

Tomorrow, May 12th, our next update for Phasmophobia will bring with it many fixes, iterations and changes to the game that bring things in-line with our vision for this update. While we know improvements can still be made, we believe this will provide a much better experience for everyone playing Phasmophobia.

Over the past week, we’ve read feedback from across the entire community. The frustration and disappointment has been clear. Below is a look at the patch notes, with changes and fixes built on that feedback, that will go live with tomorrow’s update.
New
Added a 5 second delay after you die to allow you to select a ghost in the journal
Changes
Salt will now get instantly placed at the start of the animation instead of the end.

Most equipment hold poses have been changed to fix several visual issues including wrists, elbows, arms and the equipment's position on the screen.[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37002678/cbdb6458052094f51484e6fcfc2034dde1541eb1.png"]
The T3 Sanity Medication animation will no longer play in Multiplayer
The Tier 1 Igniter is now open so you can see how many matches are left
Removed the inventory swapping animation to allow for instant swapping of held equipment
Prestige cosmetics are now free after they are unlocked based on your prestige level
Fixes
Character Model Fixes

Fixed an issue that caused problems with the character rig upon being revived while crouched.
Fixed an issue that caused character models to fall down incorrectly upon death.

Ghost Fixes

VR Fixes

While tomorrow’s update for Phasmophobia contains more than just these fixes and changes, it was important for us to share these with you to see what we’ve been working on while feedback has been coming in.

We’ve reviewed our roadmap and while we’ll provide an update on this later, we have made the decision to release a second Player Character Update with additional content and changes that will include:
Additional cosmetic options to allow you to further personalize your characters
Improved character animations, aimed at quality and speeding up the gameplay
Adding the legacy badge customisation to the shop customisation screen
Improving equipment usability and speed
Various quality of life improvements to the player character and overall gameplay
Many other new features, fixes and improvements

We know we now have a long journey ahead of us to earn back this community’s trust. We’ve begun to put plans in place to share more of our development processes with you on the way to 1.0, allowing you greater visibility into the work we’re doing and what you can expect from future updates for Phasmophobia. [p align="start"]Welcome back, Ghost Hunters.
[p align="start"]Today we’ve released the Player Character Update for Phasmophobia. The update is out now on all platforms where Phasmophobia is available.
[p align="start"]Patch notes are available below.
[p align="start"]
[p align="start"]New
Characters: 12 new, higher quality character models (6 male, 6 female) with character bios, adjustable hair colour and more.

Cosmetics: A wide array of available cosmetic items to equip your chosen character with; coats, shirts and trousers, all with multiple colour options. Unique shirts for prestige and event specific achievements. Accessories such as piercings, hats and glasses are also available. Note: All cosmetics are either unlockable in-game or purchased with in-game currency.
[p align="start"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37002678/c6c7e9c5c2dc4a1725b94dd2bca739343e0b8c74.jpg"]
Animations: Alongside the new character models, interactions with equipment, objects and the environment will now feature character animations. Upon dying, a new death animation will also be seen.

PC VR Players can enable/disable new first-person death animations with the ‘immersive animations’ toggle in the options menu, as seen below. If disabled, which is the default, the new death animation will be seen in third-person.

Player Watch: A watch has been added to the character models that can be used during contracts to monitor player sanity levels and keep track of time elapsed during the contract. To view the watch in full, players can hold the Use button when their left hand is empty or by opening their Journal. The watch will not display Sanity if the Sanity Monitor is disabled, nor will it count as a piece of electronic equipment for Ghost abilities.
For VR Players, the watch will always be visible and can be viewed by simply raising their left hand up.
Cursed Hollow Cosmetics: The Cursed Hollow cosmetic rewards are now available for all players. The Cursed Hollow Mask, T-Shirt and Necklace can be equipped from within the customisation Shop.
[p align="start"]
[p align="start"]Changes
ID Cards: ID Cards and Badges are now equipped and swapped within the customisation Shop menu, rather than the main menu.
Death Room: The room a player will enter after being killed by the Ghost has been removed, with the player now seamlessly transitioning to the Dead state.
Player’s Journal: The Journal will now appear in game when being used, rather than being a separate UI item.
The Prestige limit has been increased to 4000.
Note: No additional unlocks are available after Prestige 20.
Physics have been added to all Doors, meaning they will now continue to move after the player lets go.
Flashlights will now be held in the player’s left hand, and can be dropped when the right hand is empty.
Equipment, such as the tripod, can now be placed while standing.
All items will now be placed on the character model, rather than invisible unless equipped.
Tier 2 Sound Recorders are now included in the Audio Only weekly challenge.
The lowest FOV option is now 70, rather than 60. The default setting remains at 70.
The inventory belt has been removed, with all items now placed on the character model.
The teleport movement circle will now render on top of other objects and will be invisible until the player presses the teleport button when at full stamina.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37002678/9795a0a0049644770007a0c6dc31e3bc606ea65b.jpg"]
[p align="start"]
[p align="start"]Fixes
Fixed an issue that caused Head Gear to not be visible on all FOV values.
Fixed an issue in Prison where wishing for a trap with the Monkey’s Paw wouldn’t affect sliding doors.
Fixed an issue where the Raiju’s hunt threshold would only increase if equipment was held.
Fixed an issue where the Yokai could hear the Music Box from too far away.
Fixed an issue where the Jinn could drain sanity from a player in rooms above and below it.

Fixed an issue in VR that caused difficulty picking up the Spirit Box from the van wall.
Fixed an issue in VR that caused Salt to rotate with the player’s body, rather than hand.

Fixed an issue in VR where players would appear to slide down stairs when using teleport locomotion.
Fixed an issue in VR where players could grab items through walls.
Fixed an issue in VR that caused the Tier 3 Firelight to be held upside down.

Fixed an issue in VR that caused players to be able to teleport out of the Van at the end of the tutorial and skip areas.

Fixed an issue in VR that caused doors to push players aside.
Fixed an issue in VR that caused the T1 Head Gear to fall off players when viewing the CCTV.
Fixed an issue in VR that caused player’s models to become misaligned with their position.
Various other fixes and improvements.
[p align="start"]

[p align="start"]The below are issues that we are aware of in-game and currently investigating a fix. In some cases, a fix is already planned for a future update. Please do submit any issues, outside of the below, you encounter to our team via our Support Centre as any and all information can help our team find a fix.

[p align="start"]The following issues, as well as other known bugs, will be fixed with the launch of Phasmophobia's next update on May 12th, 2026:

We will also be making the following changes as part of the same update:

Welcome back, Ghost Hunters. We have some much-anticipated news for you.

Today we’re excited to announce that Phasmophobia’s Player Character Update will be launching across all platforms on May 5th, 2026. Stay tuned to our social channels and official Discord server for exact release timings.

While we won’t go into too many details before the release, we did want to lift the curtain ever so slightly on some of what you can expect to see in the update. A full rundown of changes, additions and more will be available when the update is released.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37002678/89e45535d6508b1705c24ae8acc85aff4334bcf1.jpg"]

Of course, at the heart of this update is the ability to customise your player character in-game. After a long wait, the Customisation shop in the lobby is finally open for business. Here you’ll be able to choose from one of 12 characters and be able to change their clothing, hair colour and much more. While the shop is full of options at launch, you can look forward to more items being added in future updates and Twitch Drops - such as the below High Priestess T-shirt drop that'll be starting with the launch of the update.
[p align="start"]This Twitch Drop will be available for all Phasmophobia creators to distribute to their communities from May 5th until May 11th.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37002678/a8f907a3f541626c39a1bd7f45d3ebc848ee7099.jpg"]
To earn Twitch Drops, make sure you've connected your Twitch account to Phasmophobia.

[p align="start"]Customisation plays a huge role in this update, but it’s not the only change. Welcome back, we’ve got an update for you.
It's finally here, the grand update for the new Progression system and Equipment Tiers.
A new levelling system has been added, with new rates of progression, new unlocks, and a prestige system.

For this system to function, all current players have been reset to Prestige 1, level 1, this way you can continue to play with your unlocked difficulties and locations. New players will start at Prestige 0, level 1.
Warning: Players now found editing their level will be banned.
LEGACY BADGE

Upon launching the game for the first time after updating, you will be presented with a new screen to choose a unique badge with options based on your pre-update level. Once saved, this is un-editable so choose carefully!
UPGRADES
Each equipment item now has 3 tiers, increasing our Equipment count from 22 to 60! Tiers cost a large sum of money to unlock, but each tier will cost the same to bring into a contract.
To upgrade a piece of equipment, reach the required level, go to the shop and press on any item’s UI tile on the screen, then hit upgrade!
RENAMING
Several names have been replaced to accommodate changes or for the new upgrade tiers, so that the word covers a broader spectrum:
Fingerprints (evidence) -> Ultraviolet
Footsteps (photos and descriptions) -> Footprints
Candles and Lantern -> Firelight
Matchbox and Lighters -> Igniter
Smudge Sticks and Censer -> Incense
Camcorders and Movie Camera -> Video Camera
Glowsticks and UV torches -> UV Light
Sanity Drink, Pills and Shot -> Sanity Medication
Head Mounted Camera, Flashlight and Goggles -> Head Gear
Weak or Strong flashlights -> Flashlight
D.O.T.S

We felt that DOTS wasn’t a very interactive evidence type, so we’ve completely refactored it from the ground up. Instead of being a clone of the ghost that gets spawned in and revealed with DOTS, the following will happen:
You will no longer get duplicate DOTS ghosts, or DOTS triggering during events, hunts or other interactions

Ghosts with DOTS evidence can now enter a short “DOTS state”; where they are temporarily visible with infrared light, during this time they will wander towards the nearest player before disappearing (if the player is in the same room)
DOTS Ghost photos now count as normal ghost photos
Note: Banshees will try to roam towards their target instead
FIRELIGHTS AND IGNITERS
You can now turn off Firelights by pressing the Use button again while holding it
Firelights now have a duration for their effects, and no longer stop the sanity drain completely, with different amounts of sanity benefits per tier
PARABOLIC MICROPHONE
When using a Parabolic microphone, you will now clearly hear all sounds you are aiming towards, within range, while all other sounds will be muffled
INCENSE
The interval in which the ghost checks if an Incense is active, is now much smaller, making repelling the ghost much more consistent
Using Incense during another Incense's effect will now reset the timer instead of doing nothing
SALT AND ULTRAVIOLET
Salt will now only reveal footprints if the ghost has Ultraviolet evidence
UV prints must now be charged by a UV light to take a successful photo
Footprints will be affected by ghost traits similar to Fingerprints
Glowsticks can now be used again after they dim to shake and revitalize the light they produce
THERMOMETERS AND TEMPERATURES
Thermometers are now counted as a starter item alongside the other evidence items
The cold breath effect will now show at 5 degrees Celsius and below.
You must now use a Thermometer to find freezing temperatures at 0 Celsius (32 Fahrenheit) or below
To receive a room temperature reading you must now hold the “Use” button for a short period (Tiers II and III only)
Room temperatures will now be much more consistent between players
Freezing ghosts can lower the temperature to -10C, non-freezing ghosts can lower to 1C
Temperatures will now drop at 1/3 the current speed, if the temperature is below the minimum weather temperature
TRIPODS AND VIDEO CAMERAS
Max amount reduced to 4
Ghosts can now throw video cameras like other items
Ghosts can now rarely knock over tripods
CONSUMABLES

Some items are now consumable! This means that if you use an item during a contract, marked as “consumable” in the shop, you will have to purchase it again when you leave.: Disabling "lose items" in Custom Difficulty will not consume items (rewards are still set to 0x)

Incense I and II

PHOTO SYSTEM

With the addition of Custom Difficulty, we’ve seen so many exciting, unique and challenging games being created, but we’d like to redirect what the purpose of Custom games is, and there are several reasons why:

We’d like Custom Difficulty to be primarily used for fun and interesting games, with unique twists, similar to other games with a “Custom games” mode, without the worry of how much you’re getting out of it.

It’s very difficult to balance each option’s rewards to have a corresponding and fair reward multiplier. Because of this, it’s incredibly quick to create games that are potentially much easier or faster than their default difficulty counterparts but give the same or even more rewards, which makes the default modes redundant.
With our analytics and player data, we can see that the large majority of players still play Intermediate and Professional.
Having a set reward per custom option makes them very fragile and limits what we can change for the default difficulties, or any future difficulties we’d like to add to the game.
Lastly, with the large upcoming changes with Progression 2.0, we’d like experience and money to be gained fairly for every player, and try to avoid any cheesy reward tactics if we can.
Because of these reasons, we’re making the following changes to Custom’s rewards:
Custom Difficulty will now have an 80% reduction applied to the reward multiplier
We know this is a huge change, but this should separate custom games into a challenge and fun mode, and keep the default difficulties as the main route for character progression.
In the second part of this major update (coming soonTM), we’ll be adding something special for those wanting a regular, harder challenge than Nightmare and something super special!
Note: Current and future challenges (like the Apocalypse Challenge) will still be accessible in Custom and still grant trophies for your collection.
To compensate for the above changes, we’re adding some additional rewards for playing well in the default difficulties, which will reward players who have the sharpest eye for ghost identification.
We’ll also be changing the rewards for secondary objectives, to encourage players to complete the primary objective each game instead of ignoring it.

items.text: Welcome back, we’ve got an update for you.
We’ve been experimenting with some new methods of game design, and have decided that this will be the final update for Phasmophobia.
We will be swiftly moving on to work on a new project named ‘Phasmophobia 2’, entering Early Access March 31st 2025 and releasing April 1st 2025.
Lighthouse
Small location with 8 rooms
A lighthouse located on a remote island in the middle of a hazardous sea
Players can complete maintenance on the light and tower for bonus rewards
Funfair
A medium outdoor map featuring minigames, a house of mirrors and a completely interactive haunted fun house
You must buy a ticket for $100 to enter this location, per player
Church

Welcome back, we've got some news for you.

Several sightings have been noted of cursed objects, in locations where a ghost is haunting. These must be the cause of ghosts being trapped there. You might be able to use these to your advantage, but be careful, we don’t know what they’re capable of.
We’ve also had reports of a strange new ghost type.
Several new items have been added: The Cursed Possessions.
Each location will feature 1 of 6 items, randomly chosen at the start of each contract. There are several spawn points for each item, so get searching!

Cursed Possessions trade sanity for information, but be warned; using these items can cause an additional negative effect, so think carefully if you want to anger the ghost for the rest of the investigation.
Music box: Reports show paranormal entities singing along to this haunting melody. Don’t get too close or you may get a nasty surprise

Nightmare has been a successful addition to Phasmophobia, but we’ve all found some ghosts are just too hard to identify with only two evidences.

items.text: Hey everyone,
This update brings a lot of important difficulty changes with the ghosts hunting phase that helps move the gameplay towards what it needs to be.
Some changes may seem significant however they have been tested over the past few months on the beta version to make sure they are all well balanced.
While there are still a lot more needed features that will be added, future updates will include new maps, ghost types and new equipment.
You can find out what is currently being worked on from our Trello: https://trello.com/b/9QrnqQ1j/phasmophobia
Added player volume controls to the main menu server screen which will carry over between games.
Added several new hiding places to Grafton and Bleasdale.
The ghost will no longer move at the start of the hunt in the starting phase which is now 5 seconds instead of 8. This is to prevent confusion as to when the hunt has actually started.
All ghosts except Revenants will now move increasingly faster over time if they see you during a hunt. The speed will only drop if they can't see you after they have checked your last known location.
The ghost now has a chance to slightly open both closet doors at the same time during a hunt.
The ghost now has a 50% chance to remember where it last saw you during the last hunt and will search that area in the next hunt.
If you keep talking inside a locker or closet and the ghost knows you are in there it will now fully open both of the closet or locker doors on it's second attempt even if you are grabbing them.
Furniture will now block the line of sight between you and the ghost. This means that there are now a lot more places you can hide in all maps rather than just closets and lockers.
Asylum: Increased the size of player icons on the truck map.
Prison and School: Optimisations to significantly improve load times and fps.
You can no longer click any multiplayer related UI buttons (join, create etc.) on the main menu when you are still connecting to the server or a new region.
Crucifixes will now cause a 5 second delay in between each hunt attempt after it gets used by the ghost.
Removed the Garage and Basement keys as they currently have no purpose.

items.text: Over the past few months there has been a beta branch running with regular experimental updates. With these updates the game has been fixed, optimised and changed in various ways to improve the gameplay for everyone.

Some of these changes are quite significant however these changes are made to improve the overall gameplay experience. This update now puts the game into a much more stable state which will allow for new content to start being worked on.
Added an accessibility page where you can swap your sound to mono. This requires a game restart.
Added a button to select the contract difficulty rather then it being random.
Added a button in the game options to change the ports the game uses. This can help significantly in some situations where you are getting a lot of disconnects. This option requires a game restart.
Added text on the sanity monitor to show the teams average sanity that the ghost uses to hunt.
Improved the server and contract selection navigation on gamepads.
You can now enter the room invite code with the keyboard numpad.
Added a button to add the max amount of each item so you don't have to spam click each item.
Added a server region prefix in front of the room invite code to help show what region you are in or trying to connect to.
Added a delay for closing the truck door once it has been opened to prevent trolling.
Changing character will no longer unready everyone.
Added an "Are you sure?" check after clicking the training button on the main menu.
The ghost will now follow your around corners if it has lost sight of you rather than searching a random location.
The ghost will now listen for player voices when hunting and will search those locations. This will not work if you are not the banshee target.
The ghost can now open lockers and closets outside of a hunt.
The ghost will now open doors, closets and lockers during hunts. This can be stopped by holding the door however the ghost can still walk through room doors like usual.
Slightly increased the ghosts chance to wander on all difficulties.
The ghost will now search around the location it last saw a player rather than searching a random location.
The ghost will now target any player that gets close to it whilst it's already chasing another player.
Professional Difficulty: You will no longer be told if the Ghost responds to groups or only if you are alone.
Professional Difficulty: The power will now always start off.
Removed the dirty water objective as it was too hard to get. It will still remain as extra photo evidence.
Removed the temperature objective due to the temperature changes listed below.
The Activity Monitor will now show an estimated value rather than the true value.
Glow sticks will now have the same brightness when you are holding them as when they are thrown.
Improved the movement of ghost orbs so that they stay inside the room longer and are easier to see.
EMF Readers will now give random values during hunts similar to how the flashlight flashes during hunts.
The ghost appearing and walking towards you will now count as a ghost event.
Dead players will no longer count towards the average sanity. Instead alive players will now lose 15 sanity each time a player dies.
Lowered the resolution of the photos to help with lag spikes when taking the photo.
The $50 photo reward challenge has been changed to be a total $50 reward over multiple games.
Banshees will now hunt like other ghosts and target any player when it's target player is outside.
Improved how the bone spawns to help prevent it spawning in unreachable locations.
Lowered the rate the Thermometer updates it's temperature from 1 second to 2 seconds.
Slightly increased the temperatures variations that show on the Thermometer.
All rooms will now start with slightly different temperatures.
If the power is off, the temperature in every room will now slowly drop to 5C/41F.
If the power is on, the temperature in every room will slowly raise unless the ghost is in the room where it will still drop.
Professional Difficulty: Due to the power starting off, the room temperatures will start at 5C/41F.
Each room will now change their temperature at slightly different speeds.
Lowered the speed that temperature raises in rooms once the power is on.
Lowered the speed that the ghost lowers the temperature in the room it's in.

Freezing temperature ghosts will now reduce the room temperature at the same speed as other ghosts. This means that when the power is off, all rooms including the ghost room will drop at a similar speed.

The Parabolic Microphones range has been increased from 8 to 30 meters. The width has also been increased from 2 to 6 meters. This is to be used to give you the general direction the ghost and not exactly where it is.
Reduced the size of the Parabolic Microphone model to give you a better view on Non-VR.
Removed some ambient sounds from being read by the parabolic microphone and sound sensors that were not caused by the ghost.
Improved how the parabolic microphone and sound sensors hear player voices to be more accurate.
Increased the time sounds can be detected by the parabolic or sound sensor from 2 to 3 seconds.
Fixed several sounds that were not being heard by the parabolic microphone.
You can now place Candles similar to the Ghost Writing Book.
Flashlights and UV Lights will now turn on when swapping items if your shoulder light was on.
Swapping items from a turned on flashlight will now turn on your shoulder light automatically.
Tripods will now always get placed directly in front of you to prevent situations where you could place them into unreachable locations.
